name: NASA 3D Resources (spacecraft, rovers, suits)
licence_summary: The repository README says the assets are free and without copyright and points to NASA's usage guidelines. Do not use NASA insignia or imply NASA endorsement; some models come from outside contributors.

licences.applies_to: repository assets, with NASA usage guidelines

cautions: Do not use NASA logos/insignia or imply endorsement; follow NASA's media usage guidelines.
Several GLBs require KHR_draco_mesh_compression and use EXT_texture_webp (checked 2026-10-10 on the Apollo LM, Astronaut and Hubble files).
Units vary: the Astronaut GLB is about 74 units tall and Hubble (A) about 525 units; normalise before placing.
